properties.name: A full orientation pass costs at most 8,000 ms
properties.statement: The four orientation rollups a session runs together - loop_status, open_questions, detect_gaps, graph_report - cost at most 8,000 ms in sum, warm. Derived: the expensive scans (open_defects ~5 s, detect_gaps ~1.5 s) are paid ONCE per graph state, not once per rollup that reports them. Measured 2026-09-05 before any change: ~31,000 ms, because open_defects is recomputed inside loop_status, graph_report and debt_since with no memo, and each rollup re-derives what its sibling just computed. Anthony accepted 2026-09-05. Bounds: release, this machine, live store, stdio. Note the ~7 s inside open_questions that is still unexplained - this budget is only meetable if that is found too.
